error: Please correct the following issue and try again.
welcome: Bring your project reports into one place
intro: Open a workspace to validate submissions, review KPIs, and assemble a central report. Try a demo with entirely fictional projects.
help_open: Select a workspace folder, create a new workspace, or try a demo. The folder must contain a valid workspace.json and project list.
help_analyze: Review the submission checklist, then analyze the inputs. Projects missing required documents are excluded; you can export a clearly marked partial report.
help_export: Export a report bundle to a new folder. Your source files stay unchanged.
help_pdfs: PDFs: project reports and overall, group, and category reports with contents pages. Any number of PDF parts can be defined, in any language.
help_excel: If KPIs are configured: an Excel workbook with totals, class breakdowns, observations, and submission status.
help_html: HTML: a printable summary with links to the reports. Open index.html in your browser.
destination: Choose a parent folder for a new report bundle
demo_destination: Choose a parent folder for a new demo workspace
no_results: Analyze the inputs to review validated results.
missing: — means no observed value; it is not zero.
refresh: Inputs are read again on every analysis and export.
title: Title
label: Display name
workspace_hint: Keep all input files inside this folder. Display names stay as entered in every language. Identifiers and references must match exactly.
chart_hint: The vertical reference marks zero. Missing values have no mark. Display controls do not change exports.
docs_pending: The online documentation address has not been configured for this build.
about_text: Project report management and KPI analysis for research, education, and industry.
breakdown_hint: Keep the KPI total and show each class using the same aggregation. Example: Publication type: Conference, Journal.
partial_explanation: Only projects with all required documents are included. Missing submissions are excluded from reports and KPI totals.
project_list_hint: Import a CSV or JSON project list, or edit projects here. Saving replaces the workspace list; source documents remain unchanged.
empty_projects: Add or import projects to get started.
documents_hint: Define at least one required PDF. Use * to match filenames; matches are assembled alphabetically. One optional or required KPI workbook can also be defined.
no_kpis: To collect KPIs, add a workbook under Expected documents, then define its columns here.
operation_failed: Needs attention — see the message above
analysis_incomplete: Analysis complete — required submissions are missing
